implementation.compilerValidation: ContentCompiler cross-checks campaign IDs, world-photo mappings, anchors, spawn/exit node IDs and roles, all node IDs/roles, and each required resource ID against explicit v1 spec sources. It rejects a missing urman.fullgame catalog, missing/unknown records, and required anchors without exactly one authored scene entryAnchorId; no default catalog/resource fallback is used.
implementation.assetBoundary: assets.spec.json is treated as a requirement register only. Its current 48 records are REQUESTED / NOT_RUN / REQUIRES_PROVENANCE; no runtime asset availability or production readiness is claimed.
implementation.physicalBoundary: Spawn and exit fields are authored logical node references. No physical safe-node, collision, scene materialization, transition, teleport, or runtime-world readiness is certified. PhotoWorldState schema and world-ID owner were not changed.
implementation.logicalAnchorBindings: The seven required anchors each have one authored scene owner; PW_PROLOGUE_ROAD binds to the existing urman.fullgame:scene/pw-prologue. These are logical content bindings, not physical placement or spawn-safety proof.
